$schemaNote: Cost tiers. Pick one with AKS_COST_TIER; the default is lean. Every architecture's .bicepparam starts from a tier and overrides only what the architecture itself forces. Nothing that bills by the hour is on in lean. docs/costs.md prices every line and shows how to check the numbers for your own region and agreement.

descriptions.lean: The default. Deploys the architecture's networking pattern and a working cluster, and nothing that bills by the hour on top. This is the tier to use when you are evaluating an architecture.
descriptions.standard: An enterprise pilot: Defender for Containers and full observability, but still no per-hour network appliances. Adds Log Analytics ingestion, which is usage-billed, so the daily cap matters.
descriptions.full: Everything this repository can demonstrate, including components that bill per hour whether or not you use them: Managed Grafana, Azure Bastion and the DNS Private Resolver. Do not leave this running.
